svg.title: Handoff Multi-Agent Sequence
svg.desc: Agent A returns a handoff command to the runtime. The runtime switches active_agent to Agent B, passes relevant context and delivers B's result. The next user message also goes to B. Runtime manages execution and state, not task planning. Transparent canvas, 2.1:1. All text is vector outlines. Requests and replies share a correlation number.

g.aria-label: active_agent = Agent B · Relevant context + findings + pending work
Next turn · Agent B remains active
